resources.string: I have read and agree to the terms above.
Games prepared on this device. Everything stays in the app private storage.
Choose your .nsp file and your prod.keys. The app validates the NSP structure and the required key generation before copying the game into private storage.
You must own the game copy and the keys. Nothing is downloaded from the internet. Independent project, not affiliated with Nintendo or any publisher.
This removes the copy of %1$s from the app storage. The original ROM and keys are not touched.
Select the ROM (.nsp) and the prod.keys file. title.keys is optional (not needed for regular games).

Required key generation: %2$d

Nothing was copied. Update prod.keys from your own console to a version that includes the required generation and try again. This app does not download keys.
%1$s (%2$s) is in the app private storage.
Use "Prepare" in the library to decrypt and extract RomFS + ExeFS on the device. The runtime and shader translation are not included yet.
This version validates the ROM and keys and copies the file once. It supports .nsp; .nsz, .xcz and .xci are rejected with a clear message.
This removes every game copy from the app storage. The original ROMs and keys are not touched.
These options will apply once the game runtime (M4) is integrated. Today the game screen only shows the Vulkan presentation path and the GPU diagnostics.
Import the port data pack (.zip) and start the game from the app. Data stays in /sdcard/HogwartsLegacy-data; no game data is bundled in the APK.
The runtime uses the bundled libdmhost.so and Turnip and reads mods/RomFS/shaders from the public folder. If the game closes, export the log and send it.
Names, sizes, Title IDs and error codes only. Never key values or game content.
Copying the NSP into private storage…

The file is not an NSP (PFS0).
The NSP has no ticket, or the ticket is unreadable. It does not look like a complete game dump.

Choose a file with the .nsp extension.
Invalid key file. The expected format is \"name = hex\", one key per line.
Not enough space: about %1$s are needed and %2$s are free. Free up space and try again.
Game runtime not integrated in this version — this is the device Vulkan diagnostics.

This build validates the container, verifies the keys, decrypts and extracts RomFS + ExeFS on the device itself, with progress and cancellation. Oodle decoding, shader translation and the game runtime (nx2android) are not embedded yet: the SHADERS and RUNTIME stages are shown as skipped, never as done.
The exported bundle contains the report, manifest and logs — not the game. Extracted data stays in the app private storage.
The game is no longer in the library.
This is not a playable port: the runtime (translated shaders + nx2android host) is not in this APK.
Validate the container and free space
Translate shaders and assemble the runtime
Progress of the preparation running on the device
The partial data can be resumed later.
Optional. Import a .zip with a Turnip driver compatible with your Adreno GPU. The driver stays in the app private storage and is only used by the Vulkan diagnostics screen.
Turnip must be built for your GPU generation (e.g. Adreno 7xx/8xx). An incompatible driver will not start; switch back to the system one.
